mpls switch-l2vc (upgrade-compatible command)

Function

The mpls switch-l2vc command enables a device to establish an MS-PW.

Format

mpls switch-l2vc [ service-name service-name ] ip-address vc-id trans trans-label recv recv-label [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] between ip-address vc-id trans trans-label recv recv-label [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] encapsulation encapsulation-type [ control-word | no-control-word ] { cc { cw | alert } } *cv lsp-ping

mpls switch-l2vc [ instance-name instance-name ] ip-address vc-id [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] [ oam-packet pop flow-label ] between ip-address vc-id trans trans-label recv recv-label [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] [ oam-packet pop flow-label ] encapsulation encapsulation-type [ mtu mtu-value ] control-word cc { cw | alert } * cv lsp-ping [ flow-label { both | send | receive } ]

mpls switch-l2vc [ instance-name instance-name ] ip-address vc-id [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] [ oam-packet pop flow-label ] between ip-address vc-id trans trans-label recv recv-label [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] [ oam-packet pop flow-label ] encapsulation encapsulation-type [ mtu mtu-value ] [ no-control-word ] cc alert cv lsp-ping [ flow-label { both | send | receive } ]

mpls switch-l2vc [ instance-name instance-name ] ip-address vc-id cir cir-value [ pir pir-value ] [ qos-profile qos-profile-nmae ] [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] [ oam-packet pop flow-label ] between ip-address vc-id trans trans-label recv recv-label cir cir-value [ pir pir-value ] [ qos-profile qos-profile-nmae ] [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] [ oam-packet pop flow-label ] encapsulation encapsulation-type [ mtu mtu-value ] [ control-word | no-control-word ] cc { { cw alert } * | alert } cv lsp-ping [ flow-label { both | send | receive } ]

Parameters

Parameter Description Value
instance-name instance-name Specifies the name of an L2VPN service. The value is a string of 1 to 31 case-sensitive characters, spaces not supported.
NOTE:

When quotation marks are used around the string, spaces are allowed in the string.
service-name service-name Specifies the name of a VPWS service. The value is a string of 1 to 32 case-insensitive characters, spaces not supported.
NOTE:

When quotation marks are used around the string, spaces are allowed in the string.
ip-address Specifies the LSR ID of the peer device on a PW. -
vc-id Specifies the VC ID. The VC ID of a PW is locally unique. This parameter cannot be modified. To change a VC ID, delete the configured one and reconfigure it. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 4294967295.
trans trans-label Specifies the value of the static label used to send packets. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 1048575.
recv recv-label Specifies the value of the static label used to receive packets. The value is an integer ranging from 16 to 32767.
tunnel-policy policy-name Specifies the name of a tunnel policy. The value is a string of 1 to 39 case-sensitive characters, spaces and question marks not supported. The character string can contain spaces if it is enclosed with double quotation marks (").
between Indicates the switch PW mapped to a specified PW. -
encapsulation encapsulation-type Specifies the encapsulation type of a PW.
Encapsulation types supported:
  • ATM PWE3
    • atm-1to1-vcc: One PW carries the ATM cells of one PVC.
    • atm-1to1-vpc: One PW carries the ATM cells of one PVP.
    • atm-aal5-pdu: One PW carries the AAL5 PDUs of one PVC.
    • atm-aal5-sdu: One PW carries the AAL5 SDUs of one PVC.
    • atm-nto1-vcc: One PW carries the ATM cells of multiple PVCs.
    • atm-nto1-vpc: One PW carries the ATM cells of multiple PVPs.
    • atm-trans-cell: ATM cells are transmitted over PWE3 VCs.
  • TDM PWE3
    • cesopsn-basic: CES is sensitive to E1 and T1 frame structures. E1 or T1 signals can be encapsulated into packets based on timeslots.
    • satop-e1: SAToP is insensitive to the E1 frame structure and encapsulates a whole E1 frame into a PW packet.
    • satop-e3: SAToP is insensitive to the E3 frame structure and encapsulates a whole E3 frame into a PW packet.
    • satop-t1: SAToP is insensitive to the T1 frame structure and encapsulates a whole T1 frame into a PW packet.
  • Other encapsulation types:
    • cep: This encapsulation type is used for CEP services.
    • ethernet: This encapsulation type is used when Ethernet packets do not carry VLAN information.
    • fr: FR provides protocol standards for the data link layer and physical layer.
    • hdlc: HDLC is a bit-oriented link layer protocol.
    • ip-interworking: This encapsulation type is used for interworking between Huawei devices.
    • ip-layer2: This encapsulation type is used for interworking between Huawei devices and non-Huawei devices.
    • ppp: PPP is a link layer protocol that specifies how to encapsulate and transmit network layer packets over P2P links.
    • vlan: This encapsulation type is used when Ethernet packets carry VLAN information.
mtu mtu-value Specifies an MTU value for dynamic PW signaling negotiation. The value is an integer ranging from 46 to 9600.
control-word Enables the control word function.

By default, VCCV in label alert mode is enabled. Whether VCCV in control word mode is enabled depends on whether the control word function is enabled.

 -
no-control-word Disables the control word function. -
cc Specifies the control channel. The control channel is enabled by default. -
cw Specifies the control word channel for VCCV ping. The control word channel is enabled by default after the control word function is enabled. -
alert Specifies the label alert channel for VCCV ping. The label alert channel is enabled by default. -
cv Specifies connectivity verification (CV). CV is enabled by default. -
lsp-ping Enables VCCV ping. VCCV ping is enabled by default. -
receive Enables a local device to receive flow labels. -
qos-profile qos-profile-nmae Specifies the QoS profile name. The value is a string of 1 to 31 case-sensitive characters, spaces not supported.

Views

System view

Default Level

2: Configuration level

Task Name and Operations

Task Name Operations
l2vpn write

Usage Guidelines

This command is available to aid upgrade compatibility. It can only be run during the configuration restoration phase of the upgrade.

  • The mpls switch-l2vc [ instance-name instance-name ] [ service-name service-name ] ip-address vc-id trans trans-label recv recv-label [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] between ip-address vc-id trans trans-label recv recv-label [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] encapsulation encapsulation-type [ control-word | no-control-word ] { cc { cw | alert } } *cv lsp-ping command:

    It is replaced by the mpls switch-l2vc [ instance-name instance-name ] ip-address vc-id trans trans-label recv recv-label [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] between ip-address vc-id trans trans-label recv recv-label [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] encapsulation encapsulation-type [ control-word | no-control-word ] command.

  • The mpls switch-l2vc [ instance-name instance-name ] ip-address vc-id [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] [ oam-packet pop flow-label ] between ip-address vc-id trans trans-label recv recv-label [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] [ oam-packet pop flow-label ] encapsulation encapsulation-type [ mtu mtu-value ] control-word cc { cw | alert } * cv lsp-ping [ flow-label { both | send | receive } ] command:

    It is replaced by the mpls switch-l2vc [ instance-name instance-name ] ip-address vc-id [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] [ oam-packet pop flow-label ] between ip-address vc-id trans trans-label recv recv-label [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] [ oam-packet pop flow-label ] encapsulation encapsulation-type [ mtu mtu-value ] control-word [ flow-label { both | send | receive } ] command.

  • The mpls switch-l2vc [ instance-name instance-name ] ip-address vc-id [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] [ oam-packet pop flow-label ] between ip-address vc-id trans trans-label recv recv-label [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] [ oam-packet pop flow-label ] encapsulation encapsulation-type [ mtu mtu-value ] [ no-control-word ] cc alert cv lsp-ping [ flow-label { both | send | receive } ] command:

    It is replaced by the mpls switch-l2vc [ instance-name instance-name ] ip-address vc-id [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] [ oam-packet pop flow-label ] between ip-address vc-id trans trans-label recv recv-label [ tunnel-policy policy-name ] [ oam-packet pop flow-label ] encapsulation encapsulation-type [ mtu mtu-value ] [ no-control-word ] [ flow-label { both | send | receive } ] command.
